{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:cane Sugar|sugar]]
*1 cup light [[Cookbook:Corn Syrup|corn syrup]] or [[Cookbook:Cane Syrup|cane syrup]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

==Procedure==
#Boil sugar, corn syrup, margarine, and coconut milk to [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar|firm-ball stage]] (245°F).
#Remove from heat and add vanilla.
#Serve warm.
